subject: Scope amendment & procurement gate coordination for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizonhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Horizon Health ProcureOps <procureops@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal intake – vendor onboarding refresh and procurement steps

Jordan —

We’re kicking off the renewal for our Redwood subscription (term ends 07/31). Our procurement team requires a vendor onboarding refresh this cycle — updated questionnaire, current SOC2 evidence, and our portal intake form completed before legal can approve. I’ve attached the standard vendor questionnaire they requested.

High-level asks from procurement:
- Current SOC2 report or SOC2 Type II assertion (latest)
- Updated contact info for security & contract signatory
- Completed vendor questionnaire (attached)
- W9 and vendor bank details (for PO/ACH)

Separately, product has noted we may want to expand capacity by ~30% given increased test traffic. Procurement flagged that any scope/price changes should be documented and attached to the renewal packet. Who should we loop on pricing and an initial mutual action plan?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Best,
Elena Morales
Procurement Manager, Horizon Health
elena.morales@horizonhealth.com

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire.pdf (1 page)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake – vendor onboarding refresh and procurement steps

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire. Looping in Laura (AM) for the capacity/upsell conversation, Ben (Finance) for PO/pricing details, and Steph (Legal) for the intake packet.

Immediate plan I propose:
1) I’ll put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and attach a draft for your intake team to review — will capture the 30% capacity uplift as an optional line item so procurement can see the delta.
2) Steph — can you confirm what legal evidence we should attach beyond SOC2 (e.g., encryption whitepaper, PCI statements if relevant)?
3) Ben — I’ll need a simple price addendum that shows the add-on unit cost and term pro-rating so Horizon can include it in the PO.
4) Elena — if your portal has a vendor portal link, please share; otherwise we can send the packet via DocuSign and HubSpot.

Timing — I can have the MAP draft + pricing addendum by Thursday EOD. Does Friday 10:00am PT for a 30-minute sync work for you?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415-555-0173

Attachments: MAP_draft.xlsx (Excel, initial draft)

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizonhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Horizon Health ProcureOps <procureops@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake – vendor onboarding refresh and procurement steps

Jordan — Friday 10am PT works.

ProcureOps note: our portal prefers the following in the packet to speed approval: completed questionnaire, SOC2 report, vendor contact grid (security, legal, billing), and a signed pricing addendum or draft PO. If you can include a short one-page summary of the uplift justification (traffic reason + estimated monthly consumption) that helps technical procurement triage.

Portal link (for uploads): https://procure.horizonhealth.com/vendor-upload

I’ll ask ProcureOps to create a vendor intake ticket once we have the docs. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

—Elena

Quoted message below:
> On Tue, Jun 1, 2027 at 09:12 AM Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizonhealth.com> wrote:
> Jordan —
> We’re kicking off the renewal for our Redwood subscription (term ends 07/31)...

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: jordan.blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 15:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: pricing addendum & PO guidance for Horizon uplift

Jordan/Laura —

Quick finance note on the 30% capacity uplift: we should present two options to Horizon — a committed 12-month seat/throughput uplift (discounted) vs a short-term term-limited burst (non-committed, higher unit price). Draft numbers attached.

If they want to keep the same term length (annual) and add capacity, we can prorate the addendum for the remainder of the term and present a one-line summary that procurement likes. Key doc items for PO lane:
- Single-line price addendum (signed) OR draft PO with pricing fields filled
- Billing contact and remit-to info (we provide)
- Bank/W9 to be provided after vendor form is accepted

I attached a pricing addendum (pricing_addendum_v2.xlsx) — it has the two options and pro-rate logic. I recommend we keep the MAP as the source of truth for deliverables and dates, and attach the chosen pricing option as the renewal exhibit.

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_addendum_v2.xlsx (Excel)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal intake – vendor onboarding refresh and procurement steps

Elena — great to align. Attached is the updated MAP (finalized), the one-page uplift summary, and our recommended pricing addendum with both options Ben mentioned. Summary below and next steps:

Summary:
- Required docs included: completed questionnaire, SOC2 link, vendor contact grid (sec/legal/billing), pricing addendum (option A: 12-mo commit; option B: short-term burst).
- Uplift rationale: 30% expected monthly throughput increase tied to pilot expansion in three product teams; estimated token consumption and monthly spend included in the one-pager.
- Timeline: please upload packets to your portal link by 6/14 to allow ProcureOps to route to Legal before 7/01.

Next steps/action items:
- Elena: confirm whether you want Option A (commit) or Option B (burst) on the pricing addendum — either is fine; we’ll prepare a signed exhibit. (due 6/14)
- ProcureOps: create intake ticket once upload is complete and share ticket id back to the thread.
- Laura: I’ll schedule the 30-min sync on Friday 6/11 10:00am PT; calendar invite to follow.
- Steph: please confirm the final list of legal evidence items and I’ll attach them to the DocuSign packet.

Thanks everyone — attaching final files for upload.

Jordan Blake
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_final.xlsx (final MAP), uplift_onepager.pdf (1 page), pricing_addendum_final.xlsx (Excel)
